layout.title: About Caprock
layout.description: Caprock is an elevated workforce community in Mobeetie, Texas — designed for comfort, connection, and life on site.

story.title: Built for people powering progress.
story.p1: Caprock was created for the people doing the work — the crews, operators, and professionals whose efforts move projects forward across the Texas panhandle. We started with a simple idea: workforce living should feel less like temporary lodging and more like a real community.
story.p2: From private accommodations to wellness, recreation, and dining, every detail is built to support the rhythm of a long assignment — a place to rest, refuel, and reset before doing it all again tomorrow.

items.title: Comfort
items.desc: Private rooms, modern furnishings, and quiet spaces designed for a real night's rest.

items.title: Connection
items.desc: Shared social spaces, recreation, and dining that bring residents together.

items.title: Convenience
items.desc: On-site dining, shuttle services, and 24/7 guest support — so you can focus on the work.

items.title: Wellbeing
items.desc: Wellness center, recreation facilities, and amenities that support how you live.
